release_notes:
1. OpenAI / ChatGPT Ads Measurement Integration: Dedicated window.dataLayer.openai_ads namespace emitting standard (contents_viewed, items_added, checkout_started, order_created) and custom ecommerce actions with command 'measure'.
2. Universal ISO 4217 Minor Currency Units: Strict minor unit monetary conversion for all global currencies (0-decimal JPY/KRW/VND, 3-decimal KWD/BHD/OMR, 4-decimal CLF, and standard 2-decimal USD/EUR/GBP/BDT).
3. Advanced Customer Matching: SHA-256 normalized email, phone, name, external_id, and unhashed address matching for OpenAI measurement.
4. Complete BO Advertising Routing Matrix: Full support for master switch, platform toggle, event routing matrix, and DataLayer purge reset (openai_ads: null).
